newsitem.title: JAPAN: Namco aims to launch computer graphics film in '98.
newsitem.headline: Namco aims to launch computer graphics film in '98.

text.p: Japanese game equipment maker Namco Ltd aims to distribute its first motion picture produced with computer graphics in the Christmas season of 1998 in the United States, company president Masaya Nakamura told Reuters on Wednesday.
He said it had originally looked as if the movie, being produced by a major computer graphics studio in Los Angeles, might not be ready until the Christmas period of 1999.
"We are considering setting up a team of about 250 employees in Japan to speed up the process," Nakamura said.
The movie will cost around four billion to five billion yen to make, he said.
"Considering the cost of making the movie, we will first show it at U.S. cinemas and then distribute it in Japan," the Namco president said.
He said the theme of the movie would be related to the environment.
Nakamura also said the company is considering expanding its business to Australia, Central and South America, and Canada. But he declined to disclose further details.
He said the company is also seeking to establish a production base in Vietnam.
